   MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  NOVEMBER 18, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Commissioner Beacham was absent. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications & Public Affairs, Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior Management Analyst, and Jocelyn
Hernandez, Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Vice Chair seconded to approve the minutes for October 14, 2024.
There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Holiday Home and Business Décor Contest

Mr. Sun provided Commissioners with door hangers for distribution. Mr. Sun explained the
LoveNorwalk.org link that leads directly to the Commissions contest entry page.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the October Celebration Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mr. Sun commented that the video has reached over 400 accounts and has been
shared 43 times. Mr. Sun stated that Mrs. Ocegueda will bring a list of themes for next year for the
Commissions approval.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Mr. Sun stated that the content being provided
is resonating with the community. Commissioner Ang asked if the Halloween Parade was livestreamed.
Mr. Sun replied that it was livestreamed, the audio was great but the feed was choppy due to not having
a strong Verizon hotspot signal. Mr. Sun stated the Justin Machaca, Senior Production Supervisor has
been improving the multi-media team’s equipment that will allow staff to livestream future events with
better video quality.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mr. Sun read an email that was received from Gina Cosylion, Secretary of the Arturo Sanchez Sr.
Halloween Parade Foundation thanking the Commission for their invaluable support in making the
parade a success.
 Minutes of the Special Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
November 18, 2024

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Sanchez stated he attended the Norwalk Veterans Villas Ribbon Cutting and gave
thanks to Mr. Sun for helping put the event together. Vice Chair Ang was unable to attend the Veterans
events due to his work schedule but he went to a watch party on election night and noticed the city did
not provide any election results on the website. Mr. Sun explained that he was not sure how the City
would be able to provide that information as the County runs the election and the City will only post
final results once all votes have been counted, which can take several weeks after election night. Chair
Leon stated she attended the Halloween Festivals at two of the parks and mentioned the festivals were
well attended. Chair Leon asked if the city monument signs can be cleaned up. Mr. Sun explained that
the Public Services department does have a cleaning schedule but will pass on the request.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 6:49 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
